question: बच्चे (Children) किस पर झूलते (Swing) हैं? 👧👦
explanation: Yay! बच्चे (Children) love to go high up on a झूला (Swing)! 🎈
hint: You find it in a park, tied to a tree or a frame.

question: झूला (Swing) कहाँ जाता (Goes) है? 🌬️
explanation: Super star! The swing goes ऊपर (Up) in the air and then comes नीचे (Down)! 🌟
hint: Think about how you move when you sit on it.

question: झूला (Swing) किस पर बाँधा (Tied) जाता है? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! We tie the swing to a strong डाली (Branch) of a tree! 🍃
hint: It is the arm of a big green plant.

question: जब हम झूलते (Swing) हैं, तो क्या महसूस (Feel) होती है? 🌬️
explanation: Fantastic! We feel the cool हवा (Wind) on our face while swinging! 🌬️
hint: It blows your hair when you go fast.

question: ऊपर (Up) जाकर झूला (Swing) किसे छूना (Touch) चाहता है? ☁️
explanation: Brilliant! Going so high makes us feel like touching the आसमान (Sky)! ☁️
hint: The big blue space above us.

question: झूले (Swing) पर बैठकर बच्चे (Children) कैसे लगते हैं? 😄
explanation: Yay! Swinging makes every child so खुश (Happy) and full of joy! 💖
hint: They laugh and smile a lot.

question: झूला (Swing) आगे (Forward) और कहाँ जाता है? ⬅️
explanation: Great job! A swing moves back and forth, आगे (Forward) and पीछे (Backward)! 🔄

question: झूले (Swing) को कौन धक्का (Push) देता है? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! A दोस्त (Friend) gives us a gentle push on the swing! 🎈
hint: The person you play with in the park.

question: झूले (Swing) को हम किससे कसकर (Tightly) पकड़ते (Hold) हैं? ✊
explanation: Super star! We hold the ropes safely with our हाथ (Hands)! 🙌

question: झूला (Swing) किससे लटका (Hung) होता है? 🪢
explanation: Fantastic! A strong रस्सी (Rope) holds the swing to the tree! 🌳
hint: A thick cord used for tying things.

question: हम झूला (Swing) कहाँ झूलते (Swing) हैं? 🏞️
explanation: Yay! The बगीचा (Park) is the best place to play on swings! 🌻
hint: A place with lots of green grass and trees.

question: तेज़ (Fast) झूलते (Swinging) समय हमारे बाल (Hair) क्या करते हैं? 💨
explanation: Awesome! Our lovely hair उड़ते (Fly) beautifully in the wind! 🌬️
hint: They move up in the air.

question: आसमान (Sky) में झूले (Swing) की तरह कौन उड़ता (Flies) है? 🐦
explanation: Brilliant! Just like us on a swing, a चिड़िया (Bird) flies in the sky! 🦅

question: नीचे (Down) आते समय हमें क्या दिखाई (Seen) देता है? 🌱
explanation: Super! When the swing comes down, we look at the ज़मीन (Ground)! 🌿

question: पेड़ (Tree) पर झूले (Swing) के साथ और क्या हिलते (Move) हैं? 🍃
explanation: Yay! The green पत्ते (Leaves) dance when we swing on the tree! 🍃
hint: They are green and grow on branches.

question: जब हम झूलते (Swing) हैं, तो क्या गाते (Sing) हैं? 🎵
explanation: Great job! Singing a गाना (Song) makes swinging even more fun! 🎤

question: हम झूले (Swing) पर कैसे बैठते (Sit) हैं? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! We stay safe by बैठकर (Sitting) nicely on the swing! 🧒
hint: Not standing, but resting your bottom.

question: झूला (Swing) रोकने (Stop) के लिए हम किसका इस्तेमाल (Use) करते हैं? 🦶
explanation: Fantastic! We gently touch our पैर (Feet) to the ground to stop! 🦶
hint: They have toes and wear shoes.

question: झूला (Swing) खेलने में हमें क्या आता है? 🎉
explanation: Super star! Playing on swings gives us so much मज़ा (Fun)! 🎈
hint: A feeling of joy and excitement.

question: झूला (Swing) हमें किसकी सैर (Ride) कराता है? ✈️
explanation: Yay! The swing takes us on a magical ride in the हवा (Wind)! ☁️

question: पार्क (Park) में कौन-कौन खेलता (Plays) है? 🧒👦
explanation: Brilliant! Lots of cute बच्चे (Children) play together in the park! 🌼

question: झूले (Swing) पर बारी (Turn) के लिए हम क्या करते (Do) हैं? ⏳
explanation: Awesome! Good children always इंतज़ार (Wait) for their turn! 🌟

question: झूलते (Swinging) हुए आसमान (Sky) में क्या दिखते (Seen) हैं? ☁️
explanation: Great job! Going high lets us see the fluffy बादल (Clouds)! 🌤️
hint: White and fluffy things in the sky.

question: हवा (Wind) में झूलना (Swinging) कैसा लगता है? ✈️
explanation: Super star! Swinging fast feels just like उड़ने (Flying) in the sky! ✈️

question: झूले (Swing) का पटरा (Board) किसका बना (Made) होता है? 🪵
explanation: Fantastic! We sit on a strong पटरा (Board) made of लकड़ी (Wood)! 🪑

question: झूला (Swing) धीरे-धीरे (Slowly) क्या होता है? 🛑
explanation: Yay! The swing slowly रुकता (Stops) when we finish playing! ⏸️

question: हम झूले (Swing) पर एक साथ (Together) किसके साथ बैठते (Sit) हैं? 👫
explanation: Awesome! Sharing a big swing with a दोस्त (Friend) is double the fun! 💞

question: पेड़ (Tree) हमें क्या देता (Gives) है? 🌳
explanation: Brilliant! The tree gives us cool छाँव (Shade) while we swing! 🍃
hint: It protects us from the hot sun.

question: झूलते (Swinging) समय हम कैसे हँसते (Laugh) हैं? 😂
explanation: Super! We go 'हा-हा' (Ha-ha) because swinging is super happy! 😄

question: जब दोस्त (Friend) झूला (Swing) माँगता है, तो हम क्या कहते हैं? 🎁
explanation: Yay! Good friends always share and say 'लो झूल लो' (Take a swing)! 🤝

question: टायर (Tire) का झूला (Swing) किस आकार (Shape) का होता है? ⭕
explanation: Great job! A beautiful tire swing is perfectly गोल (Round)! 🍩

question: झूले (Swing) पर बैठकर हम किसकी तरह ऊपर (Up) जाते हैं? 🚀
explanation: Awesome! Going high feels like blasting off in a रॉकेट (Rocket)! ⭐
hint: A fast machine that goes to space.

question: झूला (Swing) बाँधने के लिए पेड़ (Tree) कैसा होना चाहिए? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! We need a big and मज़बूत (Strong) tree to keep us safe! 🌲

question: हम पार्क (Park) में कब झूलने (Swing) जाते हैं? 🌇
explanation: Super star! We usually go out to play and swing in the शाम (Evening)! 🌇
hint: When the sun starts to set.

question: झूले (Swing) पर डर (Fear) लगने पर हम क्या करते हैं? 🙈
explanation: Yay! If we feel scared, we just आँखें बंद (Close eyes) and enjoy the breeze! 😌

question: झूले (Swing) की रस्सी (Rope) कैसे पकड़ी (Hold) चाहिए? ✊
explanation: Brilliant! Always hold the rope कसकर (Tightly) to stay safe! 🛡️

question: हवा (Wind) चलने पर झूला (Swing) अपने आप क्या करता है? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! The cool breeze makes the empty swing gently हिलता (Moves)! 🌬️

question: जब झूला (Swing) ऊपर (Up) जाता है, तो हम क्या कहते हैं? 🙌
explanation: Super! Going high is so exciting, we shout हुर्रे (Hurray)! 🎈

question: झूले (Swing) पर कौन-कौन खेल (Play) सकते हैं? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Yay! Swings are for सब लोग (Everyone) to share and enjoy! 💞

question: झूले (Swing) की आवाज़ (Sound) कैसी होती है? 🎶
explanation: Great job! A fast swing makes a fun सर-सर (Whoosh) sound in the wind! 🍃
hint: The sound of air moving fast.

question: माँ (Mother) हमें झूले (Swing) पर क्या देती (Gives) है? 🙌
explanation: Awesome! Sweet माँ (Mother) gives us a gentle धक्का (Push) to make us go high! 💖
hint: A light force to move you.

question: पार्क (Park) में झूले (Swings) के पास क्या लगे (Planted) होते हैं? 🌷
explanation: Fantastic! Beautiful पेड़-पौधे (Plants) grow all around the swings in a park! 🌻

question: ऊपर (Up) से देखने पर नीचे के लोग (People) कैसे दिखते हैं? 🐜
explanation: Super star! When we are high up, everything below looks छोटे (Small)! 🔭

question: झूले (Swing) से हमें क्या मिलती (Gets) है? 🌟
explanation: Yay! Playing on swings fills our hearts with खुशी (Joy)! ❤️

question: पेड़ (Tree) पर रहने वाले कौन से जानवर (Animals) झूलते हैं? 🐒
explanation: Brilliant! Naughty बंदर (Monkey) also love to swing on tree branches! 🌴

question: झूलते (Swinging) समय हमें क्या गिनना (Count) अच्छा लगता है? 🔢
explanation: Awesome! We love to count गिनती (Numbers) like one, two, three while swinging! 🎲

question: दोस्त (Friend) को झूले (Swing) पर धक्का देते (Pushing) समय कैसा धक्का देना चाहिए? ✋
explanation: Great job! Always push your friend धीरे (Gently) so they stay safe! 🛡️

question: झूला (Swing) खेलते समय हमें किसके साथ मिल-जुलकर (Together) रहना चाहिए? 🤝
explanation: Super! Playing nicely with दोस्तों (Friends) makes everyone happy! 🎈
hint: The children who play with you.

question: झूले (Swing) पर ऊपर (Up) जाते हुए हमें कौन सी रोशनी (Light) छूती है? ☀️
explanation: Yay! The warm धूप (Sunlight) feels so nice when we swing high! ☀️

question: हमारा झूला (Swing) हमें कैसी सैर (Ride) कराता है? 🌈
explanation: Fantastic! A swing ride is the most मज़ेदार (Fun) thing in the world! 🌟
